name: Ushanti
description: A leonin shaman who heals Glissa and had a vision of her involved in the end of the world.

description_citations.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ushanti recounts a vision of the end of times in which all leonin are torn from the world.
timeline.quote: I have seen the end of times, a future in which all our kind are torn from this world.

citation.text: Soulscour (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ushanti prophesies that guardians will be needed more than ever.
timeline.quote: If what I have seen comes to pass, we will need our guardians more than ever.

citation.text: Skyhunter Prowler (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bruenna is restored on another world without memories and helps build Lume and negotiate a peace treaty.
timeline.quote: There, she helped build the city of Lume and negotiate a peace treaty

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Taj-Nar Ushanti sees a vision of Glissa and Raksha sends the pair to find the cloaked figure.
timeline.quote: He cannot leave during the siege, but he sends the pair to find the cloaked figure.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "At Taj-Nar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aerophins attack Taj-Nar and Rishan is killed by exploding artifacts as Glissa crashes the aerophin.
timeline.quote: Rishan steps out of a doorway and is killed by the exploding artifacts.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "The Mephidross and finding Bosh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A leonin seer who speaks of the wisdom of elders as a weapon.
